title: The Plus-Size Fiancée Both Brothers Wanted
synopsis: Everyone at Aldwell University is waiting for plus-size freshman Tanya Jordan to get dumped by her rich fiancé, Ethan Cross. Their engagement is only a one-year deal meant to save her family—but everything changes when Ethan’s dangerous older brother, Leo, discovers Tanya is the girl who saved his life thirteen years ago. As Leo falls for her openly and Ethan realizes his feelings are no longer fake, Tanya suddenly becomes the woman both Cross brothers refuse to let go.
